questions.question: The price of an item decreases by 10% every year. If the difference between its prices at the end of the 4th year and 5th year is Rs.52.65, then 90% of its price at the end of the 2ⁿd year is∶
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Price is decreased by 10% every year.

Difference between by 4th year and 5th year is Rs. 52.65

**Calculation:**

Let the price of an item be Rs. x

Price decreased by 10% every year.

10% = 10/100 = 1/10

⇒ Price decreased from 10 to (10 – 1) = 9

Price after 4 years,

⇒ x × 9/10 × 9/10 × 9/10 × 9/10

⇒ x(9/10)⁴

Price after 5 years,

⇒ x × 9/10 × 9/10 × 9/10 × 9/10 × 9/10

⇒ x(9/10)5

Now according to the question,

⇒ x(9/10)4 – x(9/10)5 = 52.65

⇒ x(9/10)4 {1 – (9/10)} = 52.65

⇒ x(9/10)4 × 1/10 = 52.65

⇒ x(9/10)4 = 526.5

⇒ x = (526.5 × 10 × 10 × 10 × 10)/(9 × 9 × 9 × 9)

⇒ x = 802.46

Now 90% of a price after 2ⁿd year,

⇒ 90/100 × 9/10 × 9/10 × 802.46

⇒ 584.99 ≈ 585

**∴ The value of 90% of 2ⁿd year price is Rs. 585**

questions.question: A is 48% more than B, and C is 30% less than the sum of A and B, By what percentage is C more than A (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A is 48% more than B, 

C is 30% less than the sum of A and B,

**Calculation:**

Let B be 100,

A is 48% more than B,

⇒ A = 100 + 48% of A

⇒ A = 100 + 48 = 148

C is 30% less than (A + B),

⇒ C = (100 – 30)/100 of (A + B)

⇒ C = 70/100 × (100 + 148)

⇒ C = 70 × 2.48 = 173.6

C is more than A by,

⇒ 173.6 – 148 = 25.6

C is percent more than A,

⇒ 25.6/148 × 100

⇒ 17.29 ≈ 17.3

**∴ C is more than A by 17.3% **

questions.question: A person rows 30 km upstream and the same distance downstream. The total time taken by him for this whole journey is 3dfrac{1}{5} hours. If the speed of the stream is 5 km/h, then in how many hours does the person row a distance of 144 km upstream?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

30km upstream and downstream distance.

Time taken is 16/5 hours.

Speed of stream is 5 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

Speed in upstream direction = x – y

Speed in downstream direction = x + y

Where,

x is speed of a boat in still water & y is speed of a stream

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒ 16/5 = 30/(x – y) + 30/x + y)

⇒ 16/5 = 30/(x – 5) + 30/(x + 5)

⇒ 16/5 = {30(x + 5) + 30(x – 5)}/(x – 5)(x + 5)

⇒ 16/5 = (30x + 150 + 30x – 150)/(x² – 25)

⇒ 16/5 = 60x/(x2 – 25)

⇒ 4/5 = 15x/(x2 – 25)

⇒ 4(x2 – 25) = 5 × 15x

⇒ 4x² – 100 = 75x

⇒ 4x2 – 75x – 100 = 0

⇒ 4x2 – 80x + 5x – 100 = 0

⇒ 4x(x – 20) + 5 (x – 20) = 0

⇒ 4x + 5 = 0 or x – 20 = 0

⇒ x = –5/4 or x = 20 

Speed can not be negative, 

⇒ x = 20

Upstream speed = x – y

⇒ Upstream speed = 20 – 5

⇒ Upstream speed = 15km/hr

To cover 144 km distance upstream,

⇒ Time = 144/15 = 9.6

**∴ Time taken to cover 144 km distance is 9.6 hours.**

questions.question: If a sum of Rs.4,648 is divided into three parts such that 4 times the first part is equal to 5 times the second part and 7 times the third part, then the difference between the second and third part is∶
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum is Rs. 4,648 into 3 parts 

**Calculation:**

Let the three parts be x, y, and z

According to question,

⇒ 4x = 5y = 7z

x = 5 × 7 = 35

y = 4 × 7 = 28 

z = 4 × 5 = 20

We know that,

⇒ x + y + z = 4,648

⇒ 35 + 28 + 20 = 4,648

⇒ 83 = 4,648

⇒ 1 = 4,648/83

⇒ 1 = 56

Now difference between second and third part is,

⇒ y – z = 28 – 20

⇒ y – z = 8 

⇒ y – z = 8 × 56 = Rs. 448

**∴ The difference between second and third part is Rs. 448.**

questions.question: The average of a ten numbers is 72.8. The average of the first six numbers is 88.5 and the average of the last five numbers is 64.4. If the 6th number is excluded, then what is the average of the remaining numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 10 numbers is 72.8

Average of first 6 numbers is 88.5

Average of last five numbers is 64.4

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all observations/Total number of observations

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of all 10 numbers = 72.8 × 10 = 728

⇒ Sum of first 6 numbers = 88.5 × 6 = 531

⇒ Sum of last 5 numbers = 64.4 × 5 = 322

Sum of total 11 numbers = Sum of first 6 numbers + Sum of last 5 numbers

⇒ Sum of total 11 numbers = 531 + 322 = 853

But Sum of 10 numbers is 728

Number 6 is counted twice,

⇒ Number 6 = 853 – 728 = 125

Now number 6 is excluded ,

⇒ New sum = 728 – 125 = 603

Average of remaining 9 numbers,

⇒ Average = Sum of 9 numbers/ 9

⇒ Average = 603/9 = 67

**∴ The average remaining 9 numbers is 67.**

questions.question: Pipe A is a filling pipe, while B and C are emptying pipes. Pipe A alone can fill a tank in 10 hours and pipe C alone can empty the full tank in 24 hours. If all three pipes are opened together, the tank is completely filled in 40 hours. In how many hours can pipe B alone empty two-third part of the tank?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__****Note:** Positive sign indicates that the tank is getting filled

Negative sign indicates that the tank is getting emptied.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bda3f1c2830e6e78c9ca4155340849e6024c4c23982ae83f73cb6e019bc21982.png] 

⇒ Efficiency of A = 12

⇒ Efficiency of C = -5

⇒ Efficiency of (A - B - C) = 3

So, Efficiency of B

⇒ 12 - B - 5 = 3

⇒ B = 12 - 8 = 4 

⇒ Total work = 120

⇒ Two-third of the total work = 120 × (2/3) = 80

⇒ Time taken by B to empty two-third of the tank = 80/4 = 20 hr

**∴ The correct answer id Option 2).**

**Given:**

Pipe A fills in 10 hours

Pipe C empties in 24 hours

Pipes A, B, and C together fill in 40 hours

**Concept Used:** 

Capacity of a tank is LCM of time taken by all pipes to fill and empty the tank.

Efficiency of Pipe = Capacity of a tank/ Time taken to fill the tank

**Calculation:**

Capacity of a tank is the LCM of 10, 24, and 40

⇒ Capacity of a tank = 120 liters.

Efficiency of Pipe A = 120/10 = 12 liters/hour

Efficiency of Pipe C = 120/24 = 5 liters/hour

Efficiency of Pipe A – B – C(– because B and C empties the tank) = 120/40

⇒ Efficiency of Pipe A – B – C = 30 liters/hour

Putting the values of result (I) and (II), in above equation

⇒ 12 – B – 5 = 3

⇒ B = 4 liters/hour 

Now B needs to empty 2/3rd of a tank,

⇒ 2/3 × 120 = 80

Time taken by Pipe B,

⇒ 80/4 = 20 

**∴ Time taken by Pipe B to empty the 2/3rd tank is 20 hours.**

questions.question: A sum amounts to Rs.37,044 in 3 years at 5% p.a., interest is compounded yearly. If the same sum amounts to Rs.x in 2 years at 15% p.a. when the interest is compounded 8-monthly, then the value of x (in Rs) is∶
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum amounts to Rs.37,044 in 3 years at 5% p.a.

**Formula Used:**

For CI,

A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ,

Where,

CI is compound interest & A is amount,

P is principle, R is rate of interest,

N is total number of years

**Calculation:**

Using the formula,

⇒ 37,044 = P(1 + 5/100)³

⇒ 37,044 = P(21/20)³

⇒ P = (37,044 × 20 × 20 × 20)/(21 × 21 × 21)

⇒ P = 4 × 20 × 20 × 20 = 32,000

Now the same P is compounded 8-monthly for 2 years at 15% p.a.

Time = 2 years

⇒ Time = 2 × 12 months = 24 months

Compounded 8-monthly,

⇒ Time = 24/8 = 3 

Rate when compounded annually = 15%

When compounded 8-monthly,

⇒ R = 15% × 8/12 = 10%

Now using the formula for amount,

⇒ A = 32,000(1 + 10/100)³

⇒ A = 32,000 × (11/10)³

⇒ A = 32,000 × 11/10 × 11/10 × 11/10

⇒ A = 32 × 11 × 11 × 11 = 42,592

**∴ The amount is Rs. 42,592.**

questions.question: In a division sum, the divisor is 14 times the quotient and 7 times the remainder. If the remainder is 34, then the dividend is∶
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Divisor is 14 times the quotient and 7 times the remainder

Remainder is 34

**Formula Used:**

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

**Calculation:**

Divisor is 7 times the remainder,

⇒ Divisor = 7 × 34 = 238 

238 is 14 times of the quotient,

⇒ 238 = 14 × quotient

⇒ Quotient = 238/14 = 17

Dividend = 238 × 17 + 34

⇒ Dividend = 4,080

**∴ The dividend is 4,080.**

questions.question: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 13,860 after 5 years and to Rs. 16,776 after 8 years at the same rate percent annum at simple interest. What will be the simple interest (in Rs) on a sum of Rs. 10,000 for 4dfrac{2}{5} years at the same rate?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum amounts Rs. 13,860 after 5 years and Rs. 16,776 after 8 years

At the same rate and on the same principle.

Formula Used:

A = P + SI

SI = (P × N × R)/100

Where,

A is amount, P is principle & SI is simple interest

R is rate of interest & n is total number of years

Concept Used:

SI is always the same for every year.

**Calculation:**

Increased in amounts,

⇒ 16,776 – 13,860 = 2,916

In 3 years simple interest increased by 2,916

For 1-year simple interest is,

⇒ 2,916/3 = 972

⇒ In 5 years the simple interest is,

⇒ 5 × 972 = 4,860

P = A – SI

⇒ P = 13,860 – 4,860 = 9,000

Sum amounts Rs. 13,860 after 5 years on sum 9,000

SI for 5 years is,

⇒ 5 × 972 = 4,860

4,860 = (9,000 × 5 × r)/100

⇒ r = (4,860 × 100)/(9,000 × 5)

⇒ r = 10.8%

Now on sum of Rs. 10,000 at 10.8% for 22/5 years, simple interest is

⇒ SI = (10,000 × 10.8 × 22)/(5 × 100)

⇒ SI = 20 × 10.8 × 22 = 4,752

**∴ The simple interest is Rs. 4,752.**

questions.question: Renu marks an article at Rs.36.50 above the cost price. She incurs a loss of 20% when she sells the article after allowing 36% discount on its marked price. What is the cost price of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Renu marks Rs. 36.50 above the Cost price.

Incurs loss of 20% when she offers 36% discount

**Formula Used:**

Loss = Cost price – Selling price

**Calculation:**

Let the Marked price be Rs. 100 

36% discount on marked price

Selling price of an article,

⇒ 100 – 36% of marked price

⇒ 100 – (36/100) × 100 = Rs. 64

Selling price of an article is Rs. 64

She incurs loss of 20%

⇒ 20/100 = 1/5

Loss of Rs. 1 on cost price of Rs. 5

Selling price = Cost price – Loss

⇒ selling price = 4

Now,

4 = 64 ⇒ 1 = 64/4

⇒ 1 = 16

⇒ 5 = 5 × 16 = Rs. 80 

Now the marked price is increased by,

⇒ 100 – 80 = 20 

According to the question,

⇒ 20 = 36.50

⇒ 1 = 36.50/20 

Cost price is Rs. 80

⇒ 80 × 36.50/20

⇒ 4 × 36.50 = 146 

**∴ The cost price of an article is Rs. 146**
